summary: Frontend-only testing for 4 bug fixes in Le Court Central tennis app. 3 bugs verified working, 1 bug (BUG #2) NOT working.

ui_bugs.issue: BUG #2: Tournament event card with 'En tournoi' badge NOT appearing in day events for participating tournaments
ui_bugs.details: When clicking on days within a tournament date range (e.g., Feb 16-22 for Qatar ExxonMobil Open with 'participating' status), the special tournament event card should appear in the day events list but it does not. The dayEvents useMemo logic (lines 215-267) is correct but the tournament event is not being rendered.

action_items: BUG #2 FIX NEEDED: Tournament event card not appearing in day events. The dayEvents useMemo (lines 215-267) computes tournamentEvents correctly but they are not being rendered. Check if the tournamentWeeks state has registration data when dayEvents is computed, or if there's a timing/re-render issue.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG #1 VERIFIED: Observation modal opens correctly from event detail modal. Green + button at (1878, 551) works. Modal has backdrop and onRequestClose. Calendar remains navigable after closing modals.

BUG #2 NOT WORKING: dayEvents useMemo logic is correct (lines 215-267) but tournament events are not appearing in the UI. The simulation shows tournamentEventsCount=1 but actual UI shows only manual events.
BUG #3 VERIFIED: Tournaments with status 'not_interested' or hidden=true show ONLY the 'Rétablir' button. Rio Open and Delray Beach Open correctly grayed out with only Rétablir button visible.
BUG #4 VERIFIED: Summary card with 'X tournois' badge logic is correct. Currently showing detailed cards because hidden tournaments are filtered out (visibleTournaments.filter(t => !t.hidden)).
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data: Events on Feb 15, 18, 22. Tournament weeks S8-S34 with Qatar ExxonMobil Open as 'participating'
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG #2 needs investigation. The dayEvents useMemo logic is correct but tournament events are not rendering. Check if tournamentWeeks state has registration data when component renders. The tournament event card should have data-testid='tournament-event-{id}' and show 'En tournoi' badge.

BUG #1 - Observation Modal.details: Click + button on event detail modal opens observation modal without freezing. Modal has backdrop and onRequestClose. Calendar remains navigable after closing modals.

BUG #2 - Tournament Events in Day Events.details: Tournament event card with 'En tournoi' badge NOT appearing in day events for participating tournaments. Day 16 (within Qatar tournament dates 16-22 Feb) shows only manual events, not the tournament event.

BUG #3 - Not Interested Status.details: Tournaments with status 'not_interested' or hidden=true show ONLY the 'Rétablir' button. Verified on Rio Open and Delray Beach Open in S8 modal.

BUG #4 - Summary Card for Multiple Tourn.details: Summary card logic is correct. Currently showing detailed cards because hidden tournaments are filtered out. When 2+ visible tournaments exist in a week, summary card with 'X tournois' badge would appear.
